events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Smith Jr. (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Smith Jr. makes a secondary movement on his contest, and more-than-marginal contact occurs with Cissoko's (POR) wrist after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Clingan (POR) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Cissoko (POR) brings his hands towards Thompson (HOU) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Durant (HOU) legally contests Camara's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Adams (HOU) and Cissoko (POR) mutually engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Adams (HOU) does not make any illegal contact to Cissoko (POR) prior to him releasing the errant pass attempt.
Avdija's (POR) left hand makes incidental hand-on-ball contact that dislodges the ball away from Thompson (HOU). Any arm contact that follows is deemed incidental.
Clingan (POR) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sharpe (POR) deflects the loose ball off of Durant's (HOU) planted foot and the foot-to-ball contact is not intentional.
Avdija (POR) and Adams (HOU) make clean contact with the ball to hold it simultaneously and a jump ball is correctly called.
Avdija (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Camara (POR) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.

Adams (HOU) grasps Clingan's (POR) jersey with his right hand and simultaneously, Clingan grasps Adams' right arm during the rebound. Adams and Clingan release from the mutual engagement and the contact is marginal.
Cissoko (POR) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Smith Jr. (HOU).
Avdija (POR) saves the ball from going out of bounds prior to his body touching the sideline out of bounds.
Sheppard (HOU) initiates contact with Camara's (POR) arm and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Durant (HOU) lifts his left arm and marginal contact occurs with Avdija's (POR) left arm as he defends on the perimeter.
Clingan (POR) legally contests Thompson's (HOU) floating shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Thompson (HOU) cleanly dislodges the ball from Avdija (POR) and is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with the Trail Blazers.

Cissoko (POR) makes contact with the ball during his steal attempt from Sheppard (HOU).
Cissoko (POR) legally contests Sheppard's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Clingan (POR).
